blocks.text: Gurde khoon se metabolic fuzlaat aur zaid pani chhaan kar peshab ki shakal mein nikalte hain. Peshab nephron mein teen qadmon mein banta hai: glomerular filtration, selective reabsorption aur tubular secretion.

Glomerular filtration (ultrafiltration) aik tabai (physical) amal hai. Efferent arteriole afferent arteriole se tang hai, is liye glomerulus ki capillaries mein khoon nisbatan zyada dabao par rehta hai. Yeh dabao pani, urea, glucose, amino acids, vitamins aur namak (Na+, K+, Cl-) ko khoon se Bowman's capsule mein dhakelta hai. Khoon ke mayi hisse ka taqreeban paanchwan hissa (20%) capsule mein chhan kar glomerular filtrate banta hai. Plasma proteins (albumin, globulins) aur khoon ke cells capillary ki deewar se guzarne ke liye bare hain aur khoon mein rehte hain.
Filtrate mein fuzlaat ke saath zaroori ghiza (nutrients) bhi hoti hai. Selective reabsorption mufeed cheezon ko renal tubule se wapas peritubular capillaries mein le jata hai.

items: Proximal convoluted tubule: zyada tar reabsorption yahin hota hai; taqreeban 75% pani osmosis se wapas jata, aur glucose, amino acids aur namak (sodium, potassium, calcium) active transport se.
Loop of Henle ki descending limb: mazeed pani wapas liya jata hai.
Ascending limb: pani ke liye band (impermeable), magar namak ko active transport se tubule se bahar nikalti hai.
Distal convoluted tubule: kuch pani aur namak jazb hota hai.
Collecting duct: pani ke reabsorption ki aakhri jagah.

blocks.text: Tubular secretion reabsorption ka ulat hai: distal convoluted tubule ke epithelial cells aas paas ke khoon se cheezein le kar filtrate mein dalte hain. In mein hydrogen ions, ammonium, potassium ions aur metabolic zehreele madde ya dawaon ke baqiyat, jaise penicillin, shamil hain. Hydrogen ions secrete kar ke gurde khoon ka acid-base tawazun (pH) qaim rakhne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab tubular secretion sirf distal convoluted tubule mein batati hai. Secretion proximal tubule (maslan penicillin jaisi kai dawaon ka) aur collecting duct mein bhi hota hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: nephron par number wale qadam: 1 glomerulus se capsule mein zyada dabao par filtration; 2 reabsorption, zyada tar proximal tubule mein, glucose, amino acids, namak aur taqreeban 75% pani ki; 3 distal tubule mein H+, NH4+, K+ aur dawaon ka secretion. Medulla gehrai ke saath zyada namkeen dikhaya gaya; descending limb se pani nikalta, ascending limb se Na+ bahar pump hota, aur collecting duct se pani nikalta hai. Daen: ADH aur aldosterone ke flow charts.

blocks.long_description: Peshab teen qadmon mein banta hai. Filtration: efferent arteriole afferent se tang hai, is liye glomerulus mein dabao zyada rehta aur pani, urea, glucose, amino acids, vitamins aur namak ko Bowman's capsule mein dhakelta hai, plasma ka taqreeban paanchwan hissa, jabke proteins aur cells khoon mein rehte hain. Reabsorption: zyada tar mufeed cheezein proximal tubule mein wapas jati hain; descending limb pani nikalne deti, ascending limb namak bahar pump karti, aur distal tubule aur collecting duct mazeed wapas lete hain. Secretion: distal tubule H+, NH4+, K+ aur dawayein shamil karta hai. Loop se bana namkeen medulla collecting duct se pani kheenchta hai, zyada jab ADH duct ko pani ke liye khula (permeable) kar de; aldosterone distal tubule aur duct se Na+ wapas lene par majboor karta aur pani us ke peeche jata hai.

blocks.text: Collecting ducts se peshab renal pelvis se ho kar ureter aur phir urinary bladder mein jata hai; bladder ka sukarna use urethra se bahar dhakelta hai. Aik naarmal baligh din mein 1 se 2 L peshab karta hai. Miqdar badalti rehti hai: zyada pani ya mashroobat peshab barhate hain, namkeen ghiza jism mein pani rok kar use kam karti hai, aur warzish saans aur paseene mein pani zaya hone se use kam karti hai.

blocks.title: Excretion aur osmoregulation
blocks.text: Fuzlaat nikalte hue gurde osmoregulation bhi karte hain: jism ke mayaat hypotonic hon to patla peshab aur hypertonic hon ya pani ki kami ho to gaarha peshab banate hain. Garam mausam mein paseene se zyada pani zaya hota hai, to gurde pani bachate aur thora gaarha peshab banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Glucose khoon mein hota hai magar aam taur par peshab mein kyun nahi hota?
blocks.explanation: Glucose Bowman's capsule mein chhan jata hai, magar proximal convoluted tubule mein active transport se sara khoon mein wapas le liya jata hai.

items: Filtration: glomerulus ka zyada dabao (tang efferent arteriole) plasma ka 20% capsule mein dhakelta; proteins aur cells rehte hain.
Reabsorption: zyada tar PCT (75% pani, sara glucose aur amino acids); secretion: H+, NH4+, K+, dawayein; din mein 1 se 2 L peshab.
